observations: Photo shows a car engine assembly on the ground (no vehicle attached).
Engine appears to have intake/external components and wiring harnesses visible; no clear brand/model markings are readable.
No close-up of engine ID plate, VIN/engine code, or any label.
No running video, dashboard/ECU readout, or compression/leak test evidence shown.
No photo of underside/pan, oil condition, or any signs of repairs/cracks visible at this distance.

claims.evidence: No photo evidence of origin (e.g., import documents, shipping marks, or engine ID plate).
No readable import/origin markings or documents in the photo.
No running/starting video or test report shown in the photo.
No audio/video of engine running to confirm knocking.
No odometer/ECU mileage readout or engine code history shown.
No close-up of seals/fasteners/torque marks or gasket condition to confirm.

risks.risk: Exact engine make/model (and compatibility) is not readable from the photo, so pricing could be wrong.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine ID plate/engine code (and/or VIN/engine stamping) plus a photo of the full engine label area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown used engine with compatibility risk (worst-case for buyer).

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” cannot be verified remotely; engine may have internal issues.
risks.proof: Short video of the engine starting and running smoothly (with sound), ideally showing oil pressure/idle stability if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven (worst-case treated as needing inspection/possible faults).

risks.risk: “Never opened” may be false; prior repairs could exist (gaskets, head work, reseals).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of gasket lines, cylinder head area, and fasteners/torque marks; also underside/pan area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially previously opened/repair history unknown.

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect accessories (starter, alternator, sensors, mounts) could affect total value and installation cost.
risks.proof: Photo checklist: all sensors/connectors, starter/alternator, mounts, intake/exhaust manifolds, and any missing parts shown clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories may be incomplete and buyer may need replacements.

risks.risk: Shipping/handling damage (cracks, bent brackets, broken mounts) not clearly visible in one wide shot.
risks.proof: Multiple close-ups of known stress points: engine mounts, bellhousing area, oil pan/underside, and any visible cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible handling damage not confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of engine ID plate/engine code (readable) and any VIN/engine stamping.
Video of the engine starting and running (include sound to confirm no knock).
Photos of underside/oil pan area and gasket/seal areas to support “never opened.”
Photos showing all included accessories/sensors and mounts (confirm nothing missing).
Any test/compression/leak report or mechanic invoice (if available).
response.reason: The photo shows an engine assembly but the make/model and engine code are not readable, and the key claims (tested/working, no knock, low mileage, never opened) are not verifiable from a single wide image. Without identity and proof of running condition, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
